description: This line plot compares the Pass@1 Rate (%) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, as a function of the Number of Reasoning Steps. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps," is linearly scaled from 5 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 5, and the y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)", is linearly scaled from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The GPT-4o model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a Pass@1 Rate of 6.5% at 5 steps and increasing to 83.9% at 40 steps, with intermediate values of 32.3% at 10 steps and 77.4% at 20 steps. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model is represented by a dashed light purple line with star-shaped markers, starting at a Pass@1 Rate of 19.4% at 5 steps and increasing to 89.2% at 40 steps, with intermediate values of 38.7% at 10 steps and 87.1% at 20 steps. Both lines show an overall increasing trend with more reasoning steps.
